item.title: Israel’s High-Stakes Election, and How Illegal Gold Is Getting Into the Global Market
item.description:
Plus, the search for “superhabitable” planets. 

Here’s what we’re covering:

  • Trump Endorses Netanyahu as Best U.S. Partner in Tight Israeli Election, by Tyler Pager and Aaron Boxerman
  • The Oct. 7 Attack Changed Israel, but Not Its Politics, by Isabel Kershner
  • A Day After Huge Riots in France, Shock and Recrimination, by Catherine Porter and Ségolène Le Stradic
